Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Rustic Cross-Patterned Stoneware Planter, 6.3"H, White and Gray
Materials: Stoneware
Accent your rustic-themed home decor with this attractive cross-patterned planter. Whether it houses your favorite houseplant or is placed as a home-accent piece, this planter is sure to capture attention, and its 100% stoneware construction makes it durable as well as attractive. 7.48" diameter x 6.3"H 100% stoneware Bring this durable stoneware planter to life with colorful flowers, or use it as a simple home-decor piece. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
